set.body: Per design fc698d6e §6 S0. At bound source 8d5b0e51: run the existing ProfileHrf ML executor suites (JVM and JS), plus a 40-voxel smoke fit of a condition (Gaussian) fit and a trial TrialRandomEffectsML fit, on one harness-seed generator dataset with ONE global pooled AR(1) plan (owner O1). Record timings for the five pilot timing quantities as a preview (not the pilot). No production changes; spike code only under tools/phrf-comparison/spike/ or a test-scope path.
set.title: PHRF-CMP S0: source qualification spike (trial ML callable, global AR plan)
